p: first year of Cyrus king of: After he and Darius had won Babylon.
mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled: Who promised deliverance to them after 70 years were past, Jer 25:12.
spirit of Cyrus king of Persia: That is, moved him and gave him heart.
all the kingdoms of the earth: For he was chief monarch and had many nations under his dominion, which this heathen king confesses to have received from the living God.
let the men of his place: If any through poverty were not able to return, the king's commission was that he should be furnished with all he needed.
beside the freewill offering for the: Which they themselves should send for the repairing of the temple.

they that were about them strengthened: The Babylonians and Chaldeans gave them these presents: thus rather than have the children of God be in need, he would stir the heart of the infidels to help them.
Sheshbazzar: So the Chaldeans called Zerubbabel who was the chief governor, so that the preeminence still remained in the house of David.
knives: Which served to kill the beasts that were offered in sacrifice.
with them of the captivity that: With the Jews who had been kept captive in Babylon.
